tree.heading: Notification.—
tree.text: A State may become a participating State under this chapter by notifying the Secretary of Transportation of its intention to be bound by section 30304 of this title.

tree.heading: Withdrawal.—
tree.text: A participating State may end its status as a participating State by notifying the Secretary of its withdrawal from participation in the National Driver Register.

tree.heading: Form and Way of Notification.—
tree.text: Notification by a State under this section shall be made in the form and way the Secretary prescribes by regulation.
